_readme: Jonah Andersson Tech store catalog. Edit freely: prices, course list, dates and links. Items with "bookable": true can be requested through the request_booking tool. Prices are shown as written here; the tools never invent prices.

products.title: Learning Microsoft Azure: Cloud Computing and Development Fundamentals
products.description: A practical guide for developers, solution architects and cloud engineers moving from on-premises or private cloud to Azure: cloud concepts, Azure fundamentals, architecture, security, DevOps, data and AI, serverless and migration.

products.title: Learning Microsoft Azure, Second Edition (Early Release)
products.description: The updated second edition, published progressively as an O'Reilly Early Release.
products.format: Ebook (early release on the O'Reilly learning platform)

products.title: Microsoft Azureを学ぶ (Learning Microsoft Azure, Japanese edition)
products.description: Japanese edition of Learning Microsoft Azure, published March 2025.

products.title: The Breadwinner’s Code: A Living Memoir of Starting From Zero
products.description: Jonah Andersson's living memoir about her story into tech, starting from zero.

products.title: Breaking Into Cloud Engineering
products.description: On-demand video course: a career roadmap for people who want to become cloud engineers, with free .NET and Azure code examples on GitHub.

products.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (instructor-led)
products.description: Instructor-led Microsoft training delivered by Jonah as a Microsoft Certified Trainer.

products.title: Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure (instructor-led)
products.description: Instructor-led Microsoft developer training delivered as a Microsoft Certified Trainer.

products.title: Workshop: Building MCP servers and AI agents with .NET and Azure
products.description: Hands-on workshop based on this talk: MCP servers on Azure Functions, Microsoft Agent Framework, Foundry hosted agents, identity and guardrails.
products.format: Hands-on workshop, 1 day, on-site or online

products.title: Cloud architecture and AI consulting
products.description: Principal Cloud Architect consulting: Azure architecture, platform engineering and DevOps, and bringing AI agents from demo to production.

products.title: Keynotes and conference talks
products.description: Talks on Azure, Microsoft Foundry, AI agents, MCP and inclusion in tech, by a Microsoft MVP and O'Reilly author.

products.title: Mentoring for developers and cloud engineers
products.description: One-to-one or group mentoring on cloud careers, certifications and technical growth.
